summary: TitlebarChip is declared private inside ContentView.swift, limiting reuse to that file.
detail: If any future titlebar element wants to live in its own file (the update pill being a near-term candidate), TitlebarChip will need to be promoted to fileprivate in the same file or hoisted to internal. Not in scope for this change but worth noting.

summary: There is no documented convention for where user-facing preferences live.
detail: Hootty has no Settings scene and this change deferred the exact opt-out surface to the implementer (design D9). A short note in context/swiftui.md or context/design.md about the preferred place to add simple toggles would prevent this coming up again.

summary: UserDefaults usage pattern is not documented despite existing usage in ConfigFile.swift.
detail: context/swift-patterns.md covers @Observable, Codable, and SPM gotchas but says nothing about how the project prefers to persist small scalars (direct UserDefaults vs @AppStorage vs a typed wrapper). A 2-line rule would make future small-preference decisions mechanical.

summary: contractor blueprint instructions requires running from inside the worktree; running from the base repo returns nothing useful.
detail: A small note in the skill instructions (or in the contractor CLI help) would save a cycle for new users of the propose flow. Not a blocker, just friction.
